blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Efficient and accurate 3D surface reconstruction from multi-view images remains a fundamental challenge in Gaussian splatting. Many existing methods rely on sparse geometric initialization and iterative densification, resulting in substantial optimization overhead and difficulties in balancing rendering quality and geometric accuracy, particularly in reflective and weakly textured regions. To address these limitations, we propose RAPID, a geometry-first framework that uses multiview polarization cues to recover dense surface priors. We integrate surface normals into depth maps using sparse geometric anchors. These depth maps are then fused across views. Curvature-adaptive sampling and oriented Gaussian initialization then support efficient optimization. Experiments on the PISR dataset demonstrate an approximately \(5\times\) speedup over PhyGaP, which is a state-of-the-art Gaussian-based reconstruction method. RAPID reduces the average optimization time from approximately 21 minutes (PhyGaP) to 4 minutes while maintaining competitive novel-view synthesis quality and mesh reconstruction accuracy. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of RAPID in accelerating Gaussian optimization from polarimetric multi-view inputs.
blocks.zh: 从多视图图像中高效和准确的3D表面重建仍然是高斯滑板的一个根本挑战. 许多现有方法都依靠稀疏的几何初始化和迭代密度,导致大量优化间接费用,难以平衡渲染质量和几何精确度,特别是在反射和纹理薄弱的区域。 为了消除这些局限性,我们提议采用RAPID这一几何-第一框架,利用多视极化提示来恢复密集的表面前兆。 我们利用稀疏的几何锚把地表常态整合到深度图中. 这些深度图然后被连接到各种视野中。 曲率适应取样和定向高斯初始化后支持高效优化. PISR数据集上的实验显示在PhyGaP上有一个大约\(5\times\)的加速,这是一种最先进的基于高斯的重建方法. RAPID将平均优化时间从大约21分钟(PhyGaP)缩短到4分钟,同时保持竞争性的新颖视野合成质量和网格重建精度. 这些结果表明RAPID在加速从极度多视图输入优化高斯语方面的效力.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recovering accurate 3D surfaces from multiview images [ 12 , 40 , 41 , 34 ] and reproducing object appearance from unseen viewpoints are fundamental problems in 3D vision. 2D Gaussian splatting (2DGS) [ 19 ] represents local surfaces using oriented disks distributed in 3D space and efficiently synthesizes novel views through rasterization. However, rendering speed after model construction and the time required to build the model are distinct measures of efficiency [ 25 , 10 ] . Starting from a sparse point cloud still requires repeated adjustment of disk positions, orientations, and scales, along with densification to establish surface coverage [ 23 , 19 ] . In reflective and weakly textured regions, color variations across views provide limited reliable geometric guidance for these adjustments [ 7 , 5 ] . Reducing scene optimization time while preserving novel view synthesis quality and mesh reconstruction accuracy therefore remains a challenge in Gaussian surface reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 从多视图图像中恢复准确的3D表面[12,40,41,34],从看不见的视角再现物体外观,是3D视觉中的根本问题. 2D高斯平板(2DGS) [19] 代表地表使用以3D空间分布的取向盘并透过光栅化高效地合成出新颖取景. 然而,模型建造后的渲染速度和建造模型所需的时间是效率的不同衡量尺度[25,10]. 从稀有点起起,仍需要反复调整磁盘位置、取向和平面,并进行密度化,以建立地表覆盖[23,19]。 在反射和纹理薄弱的区域,不同观点的颜色差异为这些调整提供了有限的可靠几何指导[7、5]。 因此,减少场景优化时间,同时保持新景观合成质量和网状重建精度,仍然是高斯地表重建中的一项挑战。

blocks.en: Polarization observations provide information about surface orientation, supporting geometric estimation beyond color observations [ 7 , 9 ] . In neural implicit reconstruction, PANDORA [ 9 ] uses polarimetric inverse rendering to jointly recover object shape and separate diffuse and specular reflection components. NeRSP [ 16 ] combines Stokes vector rendering errors with multiview azimuth consistency to constrain the shape of reflective surfaces from sparse views. PISR [ 5 ] incorporates per-pixel perspective viewing rays into polarization constraints to directly constrain implicit surface normals. In explicit Gaussian reconstruction, Sparse2DGS [ 39 ] generates a dense initial point cloud from depth predicted by multiview stereo matching, then selectively updates primitives based on rendered geometry. PhyGaP [ 38 ] uses polarimetric deferred rendering to estimate geometry and material properties, supporting reflection decomposition and relighting. PolarGS [ 15 ] employs polarization information for depth completion and back-projects the completed depth to generate new Gaussians.
blocks.zh: 极化观测提供了关于地表取向的信息,支持了超出颜色观测的几何估计[7,9]. 在神经内隐性重建中,PANDORA [9]使用极相反向渲染来联合恢复物体形状并分离出扩散和分光反射成分. NERSP [16] 组合 Stokes 向量渲染多视图方位角一致性出错,以从稀有视图限制反射表面的形状. PISR [5] 将每个像素视角的视线纳入极化约束,以直接约束隐含地表常态. 在明确的高斯重建中,Sparse2DGS[39]从多景立体相配所预想的深度产生出密集的初始点云,再有选择地根据已变几何来更新原始. PhyGaP [38] 使用极相延后渲染来估计几何和材料性质,支持反射分解和再发光. PolalyGS [15] 利用两极分化信息来进行深度完成和后期项目完成深度生成新的高斯人.

blocks.en: Inspired by these methods, we focus on geometric initialization. We investigate how polarization observations can determine the initial positions, orientations, and spatial extents of 2D Gaussians before training to reduce subsequent optimization time. Our research faces two core challenges:
blocks.zh: 在这些方法的启发下,我们注重几何初始化. 我们调查两极分化观测如何在训练前确定2D高斯人的初始位置,取向和空间范围来减少随后的优化时间. 我们的研究面临两个核心挑战:

blocks.en: The first challenge is recovering surface positions. Since polarization-derived normals specify tangent-plane orientations but not positions along viewing rays. Under perspective projection, normals constrain log-depth gradients, so integration recovers only relative depth [ 31 ] ; we use sparse geometric anchors to fix its scale. Cross-view scale inconsistencies can place back-projected points on different depth layers despite accurate normals [ 31 , 3 ] , introducing position errors into Gaussian initialization and subsequent training. Depth anchoring and multiview surface alignment are therefore both necessary. A further challenge is the mismatch between depth sampling density and required primitive density [ 26 , 10 ] . Assigning one Gaussian to each depth sample creates redundant coverage in low-curvature regions, while uniformly coarser sampling risks losing detail in curved regions. A single scale is also insufficient when curvature differs between the two principal directions. Initializing representative primitives from dense observations using curvature adaptive spacing and scales emerges as a viable option. During training, merging redundant primitives and subdividing inadequately represented regions constitutes a principled strategy [ 18 , 1 , 32 ] , so that the primitive count reflects local surface requirements.
blocks.zh: 第一个挑战是恢复地表位置。 由于两极分化衍生的常态指定了直线-平面取向,但没有规定取景线上的位置. 在视角预测下,常态会限制日志深度的梯度,因此集成只恢复相对深度[31];我们使用稀有的几何锚来固定其尺度. 交叉视野尺度不一致可以不顾准确的常态[31,3],将后相投射点放入不同深度层上,将位置错误引入高斯初始化和后续训练中. 因此,深度锚定和多视图地表对接都是必要的。 另一个挑战是深度取样密度与所需原始密度之间的不匹配[26,10]. 将一个高斯样分配给每个深度样本,在低曲率区域产生冗余的覆盖,而统一的相近采样则有可能在曲线区域失去细节. 当曲率在两个主要方向之间有所不同时,单一的分级也是不够的。 利用曲率适应相距和尺度从密集观测中初始化具有代表性的原始生物,是一种可行的选择。 在训练期间,把多余的原始人和代表不足的区域合并起来,构成了一项原则性战略[18, 1, 32],这样原始的计数就反映了当地的地表需要.

blocks.en: In light of these considerations, we propose Pol2DGS, a method that uses polarization-derived surface priors to accelerate 2D Gaussian optimization. Given calibrated multiview color images, polarization observations, and foreground masks, we first estimate polarization-derived normals and their confidence, and then we convert these normals into perspective log-depth gradients and recover depth for each view through least-squares integration with sparse geometric anchors. After multiview consistency checks, we fuse the depth maps using a truncated signed distance function (TSDF) [ 8 ] and extract an initial surface. We then fit a quadratic surface in local tangent-plane coordinates. The two principal curvatures determine the sampling spacing along their respective principal directions. Sampled positions define Gaussian centers, while surface normals and principal directions determine disk orientations. Local sampling spacing initializes the two tangential scales. Training thus begins with a set of oriented disks that already provides surface coverage. The primitive distribution is then refined according to observations and local geometry.

blocks.en: 2.1 Novel View Synthesis and Mesh Extraction
blocks.zh: 2.1 小说视图合成和网格提取

blocks.en: Neural radiance fields (NeRF) [ 27 ] synthesize novel views by integrating volume density and view-dependent radiance along camera rays. However, a density field can reproduce images without identifying a unique surface [ 36 ] . NeuS [ 36 ] addresses this ambiguity by representing the surface as the zero level set of a learned signed distance function. 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) [ 23 ] instead rasterizes anisotropic Gaussians for real-time rendering, but the primitives do not directly define a mesh.
blocks.zh: 神经辐射场(NERF) [27]通过将体积密度与相机射线上的视线依赖光相融合,来合成出新颖的观点. 然而,密度场可以复制图像而无需识别出独特的地表[36]. NeuS [36] 解决了这一模糊性,将表面作为已学到的签名距离函数的零级集来表示. 3D高斯平板(3DGS) [23] 取而代之的是将异同位素高斯平板进行实时渲染,但原始人并没有直接定义网格.

blocks.en: Gaussian reconstruction methods differ in how they recover a surface from these primitives. SuGaR [ 14 ] aligns Gaussians with the surface and applies Poisson reconstruction [ 22 ] to sampled points. 2DGS [ 19 ] represents local surfaces as oriented disks and extracts a mesh by fusing rendered depth maps. Gaussian Opacity Fields (GOF) [ 43 ] extracts an opacity isosurface on an adaptive tetrahedral grid. MILo [ 13 ] incorporates differentiable mesh extraction into training, allowing discrepancies between mesh and Gaussian renderings to guide optimization. Sparse2DGS [ 39 ] exploits geometry at an earlier stage by initializing primitives from stereo depth maps and selectively updating them using rendered geometry. Inspired by this approach, we instead integrate polarization-derived normals and use curvature-adaptive sampling to initialize oriented primitives.
blocks.zh: 高斯重建方法在如何从这些原始人那里取回地表上的不同. SuGAR [14] 坐标 高斯人与地表相接并应用了波森重建[22]来取取出分数. 2DGS [19] 代表局部地表为向上盘并取出由引信制成的深度图取出网格. 高斯不透明场 (GOF) [43] 在适应性的四面体网格上提取出不透明同位素. MILO [13] 将不同的网格取出纳入训练,允许网格取出和高斯渲染之间的差异来指导优化. Sparse2DGS [39] 在更早的阶段通过从立体深度图上初始化原始物并使用已成形的几何来进行有选择地更新来利用几何. 受这种方法的启发,我们转而整合了由两极分化衍生的常态,并使用曲率适应性取样来初始化取向的原始人.

blocks.en: 2.2 Polarization-Guided 3D Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 2.2 极化指导3D重建

blocks.en: Polarization provides surface orientation cues in weakly textured regions, but orientation alone does not determine depth. The method in Ref. [ 7 ] employs polarization-derived azimuths to trace iso-depth contours and propagate reliable stereo depths. PANDORA [ 9 ] incorporates polarization into neural inverse rendering to recover shape and illumination while separating diffuse and specular radiance. NeRSP [ 16 ] combines supervision on rendered Stokes vectors with multi-view azimuth consistency for sparse-view reconstruction. PISR [ 5 ] directly constrains implicit surface normals using the polarization angle and the viewing ray at each pixel.
blocks.zh: 极化在纹理薄弱的区域提供地表取向提示,但取向本身并不决定深度. 参考文献[7]中的方法采用由极化衍生的方位角来跟踪同位素的轮廓并传播可靠的立体深度。 PANDORA [9] 将两极分化纳入神经反向渲染中以恢复外形和发光,同时将扩散和光谱分解. NERSP [16] 将监督制成的斯托克向量与多视方位角一致性结合起来,用于零视重建. PISR [5] 直接用极化角和每个像素的取景射线来约束隐含的表面常态.

blocks.en: Gaussian methods exploit polarization at different stages. PolGS [ 17 ] uses measured Stokes vectors to supervise diffuse and specular reflection, while PhyGaP [ 38 ] uses polarimetric deferred rendering and self-occlusion-aware environment maps for reflection decomposition and relighting. PolarGS [ 15 ] incorporates polarization into PatchMatch [ 2 ] depth completion and back-projects the completed depths to add Gaussians. Our Pol2DGS uses polarization to establish surface coverage before Gaussian optimization. Sparse geometric anchors fix the depth scale during normal integration. On the fused surface, local normals and principal directions determine disk orientation, while principal curvatures guide sampling intervals and disk scales.
blocks.zh: 高斯的方法在不同阶段利用分化. PolGS [17] 使用被测量到的斯托克斯向量来监督扩散和光谱反射,而PhyGaP [38] 则使用极相延迟渲染和自闭-感知环境图来进行反射分解和再光. PolalyGS [15] 将两极分化纳入PatchMatch [2]深度完成和背向投射完成的深度来添加高斯人. 我们的Pol2DGS在高斯优化前使用两极分化来建立地表覆盖. Sparse几何锚在正常整合时会固定深度尺度. 在被引信的地表上,局部常态和主方向决定了磁盘取向,而主曲面则引导采样间隔和磁盘平面.

The input, as illustrated, comprises multiview red-green-blue (RGB) images, angle of linear polarization (AoLP) and degree of linear polarization (DoLP) measurements, foreground and polarization validity masks, fixed camera calibration, and feature tracks.

blocks.en: 3.1 Polarization-Guided Surface Recovery
blocks.zh: 3.1 极化定向地表回收

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 3 , polarization observations provide local directional cues about surfaces but exhibit two types of directional ambiguity. First, linear polarization defines an unoriented axis, making the observed angle of linear polarization (AoLP) ϕ \phi indistinguishable from ϕ + π \phi+\pi . This gives rise to a π \pi ambiguity. Second, under standard reflection models, diffuse and specular reflection produce orthogonal polarization directions. An additional π / 2 \pi/2 ambiguity therefore arises when the reflection mechanism is unknown [ 44 , 28 ] . Moreover, recovered normals cannot directly determine surface positions [ 31 ] .

blocks.en: We first freeze positions, rotations, and scales, optimizing only spherical harmonic coefficients and opacity. We then enable geometry updates with a lower learning rate. After each update, center displacement, relative rotation, and scale changes are bounded by their respective allowed ranges to control deviations from the reference surface. We also remove the original Clone operation [ 23 , 19 ] and manage the primitive set through Insert, Split, Merge, and Prune.
blocks.zh: 我们首先冻结位置,旋转,和天平, 优化只有球形口腔系数和不透明。 然后,我们允许几何学更新,学习率较低。 每次更新后,中心移位,相对旋转,和比例变化都以各自允许的范围为界来控制从参考地表的偏差. 我们还移除了最初的克隆人操作[23,19],并通过"插入","分化","合并","普鲁纳"来管理原始设定.

blocks.en: Insert targets regions with persistently low coverage. We recover patches through robust integration using polarization-derived normals and reliable boundary depths. After confirming support from at least two other views and the absence of conflicts, we sample these patches to generate new Gaussians. We first check their projected extents, then insert them temporarily and render the scene. The new primitives are retained if coverage increases in missing regions and background coverage, image error, and depth changes remain within their allowed limits. Otherwise, they are removed. We establish surface anchors from their patches, temporarily freeze their geometry, and apply a protection period for primitive updates.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 1 , Pol2DGS achieves the shortest reported runtime (4.3min), yielding a 5× speedup over PhyGaP [ 38 ] while improving both CD and F-score on three of the four scenes. Compared with polarization-guided implicit methods [ 9 , 16 , 5 ] , our method substantially reduces training time while maintaining competitive reconstruction quality. It is important to appreciate that, Pol2DGS further outperforms PhyGaP on Black Loong and Red Loong, which contain complex surface structures and fine-scale geometric details. These gains are consistent with the role of polarization-derived surface priors in guiding Gaussian placement and orientation before optimization. Curvature-adaptive sampling allocates samples according to local geometric variation, providing finer coverage in geometrically complex regions [ 30 , 21 , 20 ] . Further strong evidence that our design may help preserve fine surface structures within a limited optimization budget is shown in Fig. 4 . As shown, Pol2DGS avoids overfitting surface patterns as geometry and produces cleaner, more coherent surfaces than the other competing methods. The overall shape and key geometric structures are likewise preserved.

blocks.en: We conduct ablation studies to evaluate the contributions of polarization-derived geometric priors and geometry-guided primitive adaptation. Table 3 shows that incorporating geometric priors substantially improves overall reconstruction performance, providing an effective starting point for Gaussian optimization. Building on this initialization, the primitive adaptation strategy further improves geometric accuracy and novel-view synthesis quality by adjusting the primitive distribution to local surface requirements. These findings highlight the complementary roles of the two components. The geometric priors guide the initial positions, orientations, and scales of the Gaussians, while the adaptation strategy refines their distribution during optimization to better represent surface structure and appearance.

blocks.en: We further examine whether polarization-derived normals should continue to supervise Gaussian optimization. We compare three experimental settings: (i) Gaussian optimization is performed with an additional polarization-derived normal constraint. (ii) Gaussian optimization is performed without this constraint, using the same initialization and retaining all other optimization terms. (iii) Depth maps obtained by integrating the estimated normals are directly fused without subsequent Gaussian optimization. Experimentally, it finds that removing the additional constraint yields more accurate surface normals in the evaluated scenes. Referring to Table 4 , this clearly shows that polarization-derived normals provide useful geometric initialization but need not remain supervision targets throughout training. Subsequent refinement under photometric supervision and the geometric regularization can correct residual errors in the initialized surface.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步审查由两极分化产生的正常情况是否应继续监督高斯大陆的优化。 我们比较了三种实验设置:(一) 高斯优化与另外一种由两极分化产生的正常制约进行。 (二)高斯优化在没有这种制约的情况下进行,使用相同的初始化并保留所有其他优化术语. (三)通过整合估计常态而得到的深度图被直接熔接而无需随后的高斯优化. 在实验上,它发现去除附加的制约在被评价的场景中会产生更准确的地表常态. 关于表4,这清楚地表明,两极分化衍生的正常情况提供了有用的几何初始化,但不必成为整个培训过程中的监督目标。 随后在光度测量监督下的完善和几何规范化可以纠正初始化地表的剩余出错.

blocks.en: As a more fine-grained ablation, we compare, on the same evaluated scenes, three initialization from (i) dense depth maps integrated from polarization-derived normals, (ii) sparse COLMAP [ 33 ] points, and (iii) adaptively sampled surface points. As in Table 5 , Dense initialization improves geometric accuracy over COLMAP but increases optimization time. Adaptive sampling achieves higher accuracy and shorter optimization time than the dense alternative. Similar to the earlier finding that no additional constraint is needed for surface normal recovery, increasing the number of initial samples does not necessarily improve reconstruction quality and can introduce additional computational overhead. Selecting representative samples according to local surface geometry provides a more effective starting point for accurate and efficient reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 作为一种更精细的剪接,我们在同一评价的场景上比较了从(一)从极化衍生出常态集成而成的密集深度图,(二)稀有的COLMAP[33]点和(三)适应性地取样的地表点的三个初始化. 如表5所示,Dense初始化比COLMAP提高了几何精度,但增加了优化时间. 相较于密集的替代品,适应性取样实现更高的精度和更短的优化时间. 与早先关于表面正常恢复不需要额外制约的发现相类似,增加初始样本数量并不一定能提高重建质量并可以引入额外的计算间接费用. 根据地表几何选择具有代表性的样本,为准确高效地重建提供了一个更有效的起点.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: Pol2DGS accelerates 2D Gaussian surface reconstruction through geometric priors from polarization and primitive updates guided by geometry. Polarimetric normals, sparse geometric anchors, and anisotropic sampling adapted to local curvature initialize Gaussian positions, orientations, and scales without depth sensors. Experimentally, this initialization improves geometric accuracy and reduces optimization time. Insertion guided by surface geometry, deterministic splitting along the major axis, merging under coverage constraints, and pruning based on opacity further refine the representation. Ablations demonstrate that these operations jointly improve surface accuracy while largely preserving image quality. Across the evaluated scenes and under our timing protocol, optimization averages 4 minutes and 22 seconds. This yields a speedup of approximately 5 to 10 times over the mainstream methods while maintaining competitive mesh accuracy and novel view synthesis quality.
blocks.zh: Pol2DGS通过从两极分化得到的几何前兆和以几何为取向的原始更新来加速2D高斯地表重建. 极度常态,稀有的几何锚地,以及适应于局部曲面的异同位素采样,在没有深度传感器的情况下初始化高斯亚位置,取向和尺度. 在实验上,这种初始化提高了几何精度并减少了优化时间. 以地表几何为取向,沿主轴分出定型,在覆盖限制下进行合并,以不透明度为取向,进一步细化表述. 缩写表明,这些操作共同提高了地表精度,同时在很大程度上保持了图像质量. 在整个评估的场景中 根据我们的计时程序 优化平均4分22秒 这在保持有竞争力的网状精度和新颖取景合成质量的同时,在主流方法上产生大约5到10倍的速度.
